```{r}
#| label: vabs-ancova-interaction-unadjusted

if (!vabs_incl_motor) {
  vabs_var <- c(
    "vabs3_rc_rs", "vabs3_ec_rs", "vabs3_wc_rs",
    "vabs3_pd_rs", "vabs3_dd_rs",
    "vabs3_cd_rs", "vabs3_is_rs",
    "vabs3_ps_rs", "vabs3_cs_rs",
    "vabs3_ac_ss", "vabs3_c_ss", "vabs3_dl_ss", "vabs3_s_ss"
  )
  vabs_label <- c(
    "Receptive Raw Score",
    "Expressive Raw Score",
    "Written Raw Score",
    "Personal Raw Score",
    "Domestic Raw Score",
    "Community Raw Score",
    "Interpersonal Relationships Raw Score",
    "Play & Leisure Time Raw Score",
    "Coping Skills Raw Score",
    "Adaptive Behavior Composite Standard Score",
    "Communication Standard Score",
    "Daily Living Skills Standard Score",
    "Socialization Standard Score"
  )
  names(vabs_label) = vabs_var

  # Raw variables: 1-9
  # Standard variables: 10, 11, 12, 13
  raw_vars <- vabs_var[c(1:9)]
  standard_vars <- vabs_var[c(10, 11, 12, 13)]
} else {
  vabs_var <- c(
    "vabs3_rc_rs", "vabs3_ec_rs", "vabs3_wc_rs",
    "vabs3_pd_rs", "vabs3_dd_rs",
    "vabs3_cd_rs", "vabs3_is_rs",
    "vabs3_ps_rs", "vabs3_cs_rs",
    "vabs3_gc_rs", "vabs3_fc_rs",
    "vabs3_ac_ss", "vabs3_c_ss", "vabs3_dl_ss", "vabs3_s_ss", "vabs3_ms_ss"
  )
  vabs_label <- c(
    "Receptive Raw Score",
    "Expressive Raw Score",
    "Written Raw Score",
    "Personal Raw Score",
    "Domestic Raw Score",
    "Community Raw Score",
    "Interpersonal Relationships Raw Score",
    "Play & Leisure Time Raw Score",
    "Coping Skills Raw Score",
    "Gross Motor Raw Score",
    "Fine Motor Raw Score",
    "Adaptive Behavior Composite Standard Score",
    "Communication Standard Score",
    "Daily Living Skills Standard Score",
    "Socialization Standard Score",
    "Motor Skills Standard Score"
  )
  names(vabs_label) = vabs_var

  # Raw variables: 1-11
  # Standard variables: 12, 13, 14, 15, 16
  raw_vars <- vabs_var[c(1:11)]
  standard_vars <- vabs_var[c(12, 13, 14, 15, 16)]
}

# fit ANCOVA models with Treatment*Age Group interaction (unadjusted for demographics)
vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj <- lapply(
  vabs_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova_interaction(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = vabs_label[x],
    demo_vars = NULL,
    covariates = NULL,
    strata_var = strata_var,
    strata_label = strata_label
  )
)
names(vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj) <- vabs_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova_interaction output
vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj),
    function(x) {
      vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vabs-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(

vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft <- vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-interaction_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    Age_Group = "Age Group",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 7, 7, 4, 2)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(21, 22), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 9, 16), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

vabs_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft
```
